{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to string and inspect for hidden characters using repr
sales_df['revenue_str'] = sales_df['revenue'].astype(str)

# Define pattern to detect invisible Unicode characters
import re
pattern = re.compile(r'\u200b|\xa0|\u200e|\u200f')

# Apply to the string representation
revenue_repr = sales_df['revenue_str'].apply(repr)
has_hidden = revenue_repr.apply(lambda x: bool(pattern.search(x)))

# Get rows with hidden characters
hidden_rows = sales_df[has_hidden]

# Display the raw revenue strings and their repr for inspection
hidden_rows[['order_id', 'revenue', 'revenue_str', 'revenue_str'].apply(repr)]"}
